newsitem.title: USA: Ceridian sees strong 1997 sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Ceridian sees strong 1997 sales, earnings.

text.p: Ceridian Corp said it expects another year of strong revenue and solid earnings growth in 1997.
Ceridian shares were up 6-1/4 to 40 in active trading.

"Excluding further acquisitions that we expect to make, we anticipate the rate of revenue growth in the information services businesses to be in the mid-teens, a level that compares favorably with the 1996 growth rate of these businesses," the company said.
"We also expect solid earnings growth for Ceridian as a whole in 1997," said the information services and defense electronics concern.

Ceridian Thursday reported fourth quarter net earnings of $49.3 million on revenue of $404.1 million, compared to fourth quarter 1995 earnings of $35.8 million, excluding $80 million associated with the acquisition of Comdata, on revenue of $361.5 million.
